pr_title: Do not allow manual changes to manageFields via subresources
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
It prevents users to manually change manageFields via a subresource. If a request tries to do that we return the managedField of the live object.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #89274

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

issue_context.title: Server Side Apply: Manually updating managedFields should be impossible through sub-resources
issue_context.body:
It should not be possible for the user to edit managedFields through sub-resources (like status).

To clarify, managedFields should still change based on the changes on the sub-resource, but not be writable for the user. To modify them directly, the parent resource should be used.
